reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: ledger find recorded; 9 Nov Reel was the pre-launch announcement, this is the live update
reel_check.SOURCE: age: yes: video 12 Nov, launch day 11 Nov, under 24 hours of the live claim
reel_check.ANGLE before lines: yes: angle in the story file
reel_check.STORY TYPE launch: yes: what, who built it, what it is not (Epic), platforms and code not claimed
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: L1 names الجزيرة and DMCC, L2 فيها, L3 الجزيرة; no line opens on و
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: متاحة للعب الآن, no bare تصل
reel_check.STORY: names match names-ar.md: yes: DMCC مركز دبي للسلع المتعددة, Wild Unlimited وايلد أنليميتد, Epic Games إيبك غيمز, brackets at first mention
reel_check.POST: Arabic passes: yes: two skills applied, western digits, DeepL whole-story back-check matched (متاحة/available, ولا ترعاها/not sponsored), forward pass picked ours
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: yes: our bed, the promo audio is near silent at -42 dB mean, nothing to keep
reel_check.SOUND: no speech under Arabic lines: yes: no speech in the file
reel_check.PICTURE: footage first: yes: the DMCC promo itself, showcase layout because 720p and burnt-in text would be cut by a 9:16 crop
reel_check.CREDIT: on every clip: yes: المصدر: مركز دبي للسلع المتعددة (DMCC) over shot 0
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same as last 5 reels: yes: no other Reel uses it

angle.hook: The Dubai Fortnite island is now live, says DMCC
angle.why_now: Launch day was 11 Nov; DMCC promo went out saying the map is live
angle.what_it_means_here: Ten Dubai landmarks playable worldwide in Fortnite; independent island by Wild Unlimited, not Epic's
angle.payoff: Epic neither sponsors nor runs it

decision_log.alternatives: 9:16 crop cuts the burnt-in headline and logos, 2.7x enlargement
decision_log.pace_ok: one continuous 14.7 s official clip: the glider descends and the skyline moves the whole time; lines turn every 4.9 s, the shortest the reading time allows without cutting facts
